summary: SUPPORTED: independently reviewed all 33 sealed Chinese units in supplied narrative order (not numeric ID order), all 105 owned temporal/hint items and all 22 owned people. No repair notes or proposals were read and no candidate change was made. All local dated births/deaths/ages and inherited event contexts are accounted for; supplementary research was limited to supplied claims, needed anchors and calendar conversions. Primary Songshu 8/9/10/80/100 and Academia Sinica independently support the candidate. Ming ends in AD 472; mothers are dated by their own elevations or childbirth upper bounds, not their children's later activity. 同生 is shared maternity, not twins; sui ages do not yield exact births. The early-death terminus onOrBefore AD 488 follows completion of the biographies in Yongming 6 month two, not living activity at compilation. Zan's death retains the supported AD 478-479 uncertainty envelope across conflicting biography/annal witnesses. Post-Qi executions remain onOrAfter AD 479, allowing same-year deaths. Conventional regnal-year labels are distinguished from Western civil-calendar day conversion. No unsupported temporal geometry, local omission or research hold remains.
